welcome.title: Orca iOS
welcome.about:
Native iPhone client for Orca.
Community-made, not official.
welcome.push:
Orca's push only reaches the official app.
Send this prompt to an AI on your computer; it switches Orca to the community gateway and restarts Orca. Then open this app once.
welcome.pushPrompt:
Please set up push notifications from my Orca desktop to the community iPhone app (orca-ios, bundle id com.thm.orcaios):
1. Orca desktop picks its push gateway from the environment variable ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL. Set it to {{origin}}.
2. macOS: run `launchctl setenv ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL {{origin}}`, and add a LaunchAgent in ~/Library/LaunchAgents that runs the same command at login so it survives a restart. Windows: set a user environment variable with that name and value. Linux: add it to the environment Orca starts with (for example ~/.config/environment.d/orca.conf).
3. Orca reads it only at launch, so restart Orca for me: on macOS run `nohup perl -MPOSIX -e 'setsid(); exec @ARGV' sh -c 'sleep 3; osascript -e "quit app \"Orca\""; sleep 5; open -a Orca' >/dev/null 2>&1 &`. It runs detached from your own process, so it still works if you are running inside Orca; tell me before you run it that Orca will close and reopen. On Windows or Linux, quit Orca completely and start it again.
4. Tell me when it's done. Note: after this, this computer no longer sends notifications to the official Orca app; removing the variable and restarting Orca undoes it.

welcome.push:
官方推送只发给官方 App。
把下面的提示词发给电脑上的 AI，它会把 Orca 改用社区推送网关并自动重启 Orca。完成后回到这个 App 打开一次。
welcome.pushPrompt:
请帮我把这台电脑上 Orca 桌面端的手机推送改到社区推送网关，让社区版 iPhone App（orca-ios，包名 com.thm.orcaios）能收到通知：
1. Orca 桌面端通过环境变量 ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL 选择推送网关，把它设为 {{origin}}。
2. macOS：运行 `launchctl setenv ORCA_PUSH_GATEWAY_URL {{origin}}`，并在 ~/Library/LaunchAgents 里加一个登录时执行同一条命令的 LaunchAgent，保证重启后仍然生效。Windows：设置同名的用户环境变量。Linux：写进 Orca 启动时的环境（例如 ~/.config/environment.d/orca.conf）。
3. Orca 只在启动时读取这个变量，请帮我重启 Orca：macOS 上运行 `nohup perl -MPOSIX -e 'setsid(); exec @ARGV' sh -c 'sleep 3; osascript -e "quit app \"Orca\""; sleep 5; open -a Orca' >/dev/null 2>&1 &`。它和你自己的进程脱离，即使你运行在 Orca 里也能执行完；运行前先告诉我 Orca 会关掉再自动打开。Windows 或 Linux 上请完全退出 Orca 再重新打开。
4. 完成后告诉我。注意：设置之后，这台电脑不再给官方 Orca App 发推送；删掉这个变量并重启 Orca 即可恢复。
